title: Group Fitness Class Passes: the corporate wellness loyalty bonus on a settled pack refund
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Group Fitness Class Passes product line. It states the loyalty bonus added to a settled pack refund for a member who holds an active corporate wellness enrollment.

## Basis
A member who holds an active corporate wellness enrollment at the time of the refund receives a loyalty bonus added on top of the refund figure reached after the no-show deduction step. The bonus equals that figure multiplied by the lesser of two rates: the employer's own discount rate under the enrollment, and this tier's own corporate wellness discount rate. The lower of the two rates is the one applied; the two are never combined. A member who does not hold an active corporate wellness enrollment at the time of the refund receives no such bonus.

## Condition table
| Active corporate wellness enrollment at time of refund? | Loyalty bonus |
|---|---|
| No | None |
| Yes | The refund figure after the no-show deduction, multiplied by the lower of the employer's rate and the tier's own rate |

## Hypothetical worked example (illustration only)
Suppose, purely for illustration, the refund figure after the no-show deduction were $60.00, the tier's own corporate wellness discount rate were 9 percent, and the member's employer offered 6 percent under its enrollment. Because 6 percent is the lower of the two, the loyalty bonus is $60.00 multiplied by 6 percent, added on top. Had no active enrollment existed at the time of the refund, no bonus would be added.

## Points of judgement
- Enrollment activity is judged at the time of the refund itself, not at any earlier point in the pack's history.
- The bonus is always calculated on the figure already net of the no-show deduction, never on an earlier, undeducted figure.
